front.title: Signaling Per-Path Metric in the Path Computation Element Communication Protocol (PCEP)

abstract.t:
The Path Computation Element Communication Protocol (PCEP) extensions for signaling multipath information allow multiple forwarding paths to be associated with a single PCEP Label Switched Path (LSP); for Segment Routing (SR) Policy, these paths are the Segment Lists of a Candidate Path. However, the METRIC object remains encoded at the LSP level, and per-path encoding of the METRIC object is explicitly left out of scope.
This document extends PCEP to signal per-path (for SR Policy, per Segment List) metric information by reusing the existing METRIC object within the multipath constructs, and defines the associated capability negotiation.
